annotations.title: What past crises did to this mix

description:
Only past crises for one portfolio: 2008, 2020, 2022 and others inside its price
        history, with the fall, the worst day and the days it took to come back. Use
        it for 'what did crashes do to this?'; for the whole record use
        return_history. Give amounts to get each fall in money, in the base currency
        (default USD). Crises before a holding existed are named as not tested, not
        estimated.

base.description: Currency every figure is expressed in (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD…). Default USD.
base.title: Base

holdings.description: What is held: {ticker: weight or amount}. Weights need not sum to one; amounts in the base currency are also accepted (then the crises are shown in money). 1 to 100 holdings. Tickers as the exchange lists them (VOO, VWCE.DE, XAW.TO; 'CASH.USD' for cash).
holdings.title: Holdings

name: past_crises

outputSchema.description: What past crises did to this mix, replayed on its holdings.

_fence.description: What these figures are and are not: descriptive, no forecast, no advice. Repeat its sense when presenting the result.

data.description: Where the prices came from and what was missing or repaired.

as_of.description: Last date of price history used.

missing.description: Tickers with no usable history (left out).

standins.description: Holdings measured through a stand-in with longer history: ticker, proxy, index, from, until, evidence.

limited_by.description: The holding whose short history limits the window.

recovery_days.description: Days to recover the previous peak; null if not yet.

status.description: Whether the holdings' history covers it.

window_start.description: First date all holdings have prices.
